sourceFile: 38. BRS-161016 Report test MG -A, MG-B, MG-C of new supplier China East 13.05.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The workbook is comparable, but the draft misgroups conditions and contains incorrect outcome pairings and bogus measurement results.
issues: Primary change should be new supplier China East MG-A/MG-B/MG-C vs normal, not mixed yoke/DT/spec factors.
Decap MG-C is paired with Normal MG-A/MG-B instead of Normal MG-C.
Vision MG-C is paired with Normal MG-A/MG-B instead of Normal MG-C.
Measurement outcomes from header rows 33-34 are invalid and mix unrelated values.
Gauss and tension result sections are omitted despite cited source context.
correctionPlan: Rewrite changed factor as new supplier China East MG-A/MG-B/MG-C material validation vs normal material, with product/test type as subgroup.
Fix decap pairs to MG-A/MG-B vs MG-A/MG-B and MG-C vs MG-C using rows 26-30.
Fix vision pairs to MG-A/MG-B vs MG-A/MG-B and MG-C vs MG-C using rows 75-78.
Remove invalid measurement outcomes based only on rows 33-34; rebuild from actual Gauss and tension rows 45-71.
Add row 95 conclusion as supporting evidence after outcomes are corrected.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but several are insufficient or mispaired; final evidence must cite the actual paired data rows.
